name: What size tank water heater do I need for my home?

mainEntity.name: What size tank water heater do I need for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal tank water heater size depends on the number of people in your household and your peak hot water usage. A general guideline is 30-40 gallons for 1-2 people, 40-50 gallons for 2-4 people, and 50-80 gallons for 5 or more. When we visit for a consultation in areas like Las Vegas or Henderson, we'll consider factors like the number of bathrooms and hot water appliances to recommend the most efficient size for your specific demands.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tank water heater size depends on household size and hot water usage. We'll assess your home's specific needs during a consultation to recommend the right capacity.
